name: fix-library-extra-top-level-entries
body: Amendment. Source statement: requirements.requirement.templates-dir-layout, requirements.requirement.templates-dir-validation and requirements.requirement.library-guide-layout required every top-level entry in a library root other than `library.yaml`, `slides/`, `sections/`, `themes/`, `media/` — with the single inert exception `AGENTS.md` — to be an error naming the offending entry. Problem [with user]: a template library is almost always a git repository, so its `.git/` directory (and often a `README.md`) made `kalide init <path>` and `kalide start` refuse the library as invalid even though the library itself was fine (observed: `init: <lib>/.git: unexpected entry ".git" in <lib> (expected only library.yaml, slides, sections, themes, media, AGENTS.md)`). Resolution [with user]: the loader validates only the library itself; any top-level entry that is not part of the library structure is ignored and inert — never parsed, validated, rendered, listed or served — not an error. Amended requirements.requirement.templates-dir-layout, requirements.requirement.templates-dir-validation, requirements.requirement.library-guide-layout and requirements.requirement.library-agent-guide, plus domain.value.library-agent-guide and domain.service.scaffold-template-library; the code (internal/template/loadlibrary.go checkTopLevelLayout removed), the embedded guide text (internal/scaffold/seed/AGENTS.md, internal/scaffold/libraryguide/AGENTS.md) and README follow. Supersedes the AGENTS.md-only exception recorded in requirements.note.fix-validation-agents-md, requirements.note.fix-init-library-agents-md and requirements.note.agent-authoring-decisions; it also supersedes the requirements.note.init-library-decisions caution that a stray top-level file in a created library would make it invalid, and the requirements.note.reconcile-kind-directories statement that unknown top-level entries remain an error.
